texts.facts: The tender has been allotted to respondent No.7, who has further subletted the same. It has been submitted that in pursuance of the same, the food stalls have been installed all over, leading to blockage of the walking area on the mall road itself and apart from the fact that there are also gas cyclinders being used in impunity and the food stalls are being run without any water connections, causing immense littering and also the food standards are not being checked by any authorities, which is in violation to the Food Safety and . Standards Act, 2006. It has also been mentioned that in the designated parking lot, its top floor has been used for setting up stalls on similar basis, leading to traffic jams as of one floor is totally being utilized for the purposes of installation of stalls without caring about the number of rt vehicles used by the tourists which comes during the vacation period, leading to traffic jams.
